label: Thyroid_Gland_Papillary_Carcinoma
text:
Label: Thyroid Gland Papillary Carcinoma
Label (raw): Thyroid_Gland_Papillary_Carcinoma
Definition: A differentiated adenocarcinoma arising from the follicular cells of the thyroid gland.  Radiation exposure is a risk factor and it is the most common malignant thyroid lesion, comprising 75% to 80% of all thyroid cancers in iodine sufficient countries.  Diagnostic procedures include thyroid ultrasound and fine needle biopsy.  Microscopically, the diagnosis is based on the distinct characteristics of the malignant cells, which include enlargement, oval shape, elongation, and overlapping of the nuclei.  The nuclei also display clearing or have a ground glass appearance.
Direct parent classes: Differentiated Thyroid Gland Carcinoma
Ancestor classes (broader): Pathological Classification, Pathology, Thyroid Cancer
Sibling classes (same parent): Thyroid Gland Hurthle Cell Carcinoma, Thyroid Gland Follicular Carcinoma
Child classes (subtypes): Highly Invasive Papillary Thyroid Cancer, Classical Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma, Follicular Variant Thyroid Gland Papillary Carcinoma, Spindle Cell Pattern, Pleomorphic Giant Cell Pattern
Reasoning cues: is-a Differentiated Thyroid Gland Carcinoma; peer classes include Thyroid Gland Hurthle Cell Carcinoma, Thyroid Gland Follicular Carcinoma; subtypes include Highly Invasive Papillary Thyroid Cancer, Classical Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma, Follicular Variant Thyroid Gland Papillary Carcinoma.

label: Tall_Cell_Variant_Thyroid_Gland_Papillary_Carcinoma
text:
Label: Tall Cell Variant Thyroid Gland Papillary Carcinoma
Label (raw): Tall_Cell_Variant_Thyroid_Gland_Papillary_Carcinoma
Definition: A morphologic variant of papillary carcinoma of the thyroid gland characterized by the presence of tall malignant follicular cells, arranged in papillary and trabecular patterns. Necrotic changes and high mitotic activity are present.
Direct parent classes: Pathological Characteristics
Ancestor classes (broader): Pathology, Thyroid Cancer
Sibling classes (same parent): Spindle and Squamoid Cells, Tumor Vascular Invasion, Trabecular Architecture, Giant Cell, Columnar Cell, Tumor Capsule Invasion, Atypical Mitoses, Biphasic Spindle Cell
Reasoning cues: is-a Pathological Characteristics; peer classes include Spindle and Squamoid Cells, Tumor Vascular Invasion, Trabecular Architecture.

label: Stage_I_Thyroid_Gland_Papillary_Carcinoma_AJCC_v8
text:
Label: Stage I Thyroid Gland Papillary Carcinoma AJCC v8
Label (raw): Stage_I_Thyroid_Gland_Papillary_Carcinoma_AJCC_v8
Definition: Stage I includes: Under 55 years: Any T, Any N, M0. 55 years and older: (T1, N0/NX, M0); (T2, N0/NX, M0). T1: Tumor measuring 2 cm or less in greatest dimension limited to the thyroid. T2: Tumor measuring more than 2 cm but 4 cm or less in greatest dimension limited to the thyroid. N0: No evidence of locoregional lymph node metastasis. NX: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed. M0: No distant metastasis. (from AJCC 8th Ed.)

label: Stage_II_Thyroid_Gland_Papillary_Carcinoma_AJCC_v8
text:
Label: Stage II Thyroid Gland Papillary Carcinoma AJCC v8
Label (raw): Stage_II_Thyroid_Gland_Papillary_Carcinoma_AJCC_v8
Definition: Stage II includes: Under 55 years: Any T, Any N, M1; 55 years and older: (T1, N1, M0); (T2, N1, M0); (T3a/T3b, Any N, M0). T1: Tumor measuring 2 cm or less in greatest dimension limited to the thyroid. T2: Tumor measuring more than 2 cm but 4 cm or less in greatest dimension limited to the thyroid. T3a: Tumor measuring more than 4 cm in greatest dimension limited to the thyroid. T3b: Gross extrathyroidal extension invading only strap muscles (sternohyoid, sternothyroid, thyrohyoid, or omohyoid muscles) from a tumor of any size. N1: Metastasis to regional nodes. M0: No distant metastasis. M1: Distant metastasis. (from AJCC 8th Ed.)
